Meanwhile, comparison questions suffer true reasoning failures even when both spans are retrieved—suggesting the expanded query overloads the generator with irrelevant context. The 11% gap between retrieval_complete (86%) and accuracy (80%) is generation pressure: the model chokes on expanded context or refuses when secondary evidence is diluted.
